description: Phase 3 — Excel import/export. Backend-only exceljs@4.4.0 (exact pin), preview with per-row validation + duplicate detection, transactional safe upsert writing product_change_log + stock_movements, bulk price/stock update, import history and change log, and product/inventory export to .xlsx. Depends on FEAT-001 (tables + columns) and FEAT-002 (stock_movements semantics). Grounded in design §6 and the existing multer dependency.
steps: api-node/package.json: add "exceljs": "4.4.0" (exact pin) to dependencies and run `npm install`.

api-node/src/routes/pos-import.ts: create router mounted /api/admin/pos (requireStaff('inventory')) using existing multer (memory storage, 5 MB, accept .xlsx/.csv by extension + magic bytes). CSV via a small internal RFC-4180 splitter (no new dep).

pos-import.ts: POST /import/preview — parse, per-row validate (§6.2 field rules), detect existing products (sku -> barcode -> name+category precedence), return {batchPreviewId, rows:[{rowNum,action,data,errors}], summary}; NO product write; create pos_import_batches status='previewed' with error_json.

pos-import.ts: POST /import/commit {batchPreviewId, rows} — re-validate server-side, then ONE prisma.$transaction insert new + update existing products, write a product_change_log row per changed field and a stock_movements reason='import' row per stock change, recompute in_stock, update batch counters + status='committed'; mid-file failure rolls back whole batch and marks status='failed'.

pos-import.ts: GET /export/products.xlsx (requireStaff('inventory')) streaming exceljs .xlsx.write(res) with Content-Disposition; POST /bulk-update {field, updates[]} transactional with change-log + (for stock) stock_movements reason='bulk_update'; GET /import/history (keyset); GET /change-log?productId=&limit=&cursor=.
api-node/src/server.ts: mount pos-import router before generic /api/admin.
api-node/src/__tests__/excelValidation.test.ts: extract the row validation + duplicate-detection into a pure function and unit-test it with fixture rows including error rows.
acceptance_criteria: exceljs@4.4.0 is pinned in package.json and resolves after install.
POST /import/preview returns row-wise insert/update/error without writing products; POST /import/commit upserts in one transaction with change-log + stock movements (acceptance b).
GET /export/products.xlsx streams a workbook; bulk-update is transactional with audit rows.
Excel validation unit test passes (precedence + error rows).
`npm --prefix ...\api-node run build` shows only expected prisma.<posModel> delegate errors.
verification: Run `npm --prefix c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\pos-billing\4astore-v2\api-node install` then `npm --prefix ...\api-node run build`; only expected prisma delegate errors; exceljs resolves.
Run the excelValidation unit test (node:test) and confirm it passes.
findings:
Phase-3 Excel import/export complete. KEY FILES/SYMBOLS for later features:

DEPENDENCY — api-node/package.json dependencies now pin exceljs@4.4.0 (exact, no caret). `npm install` succeeds; `npm ls exceljs` => exceljs@4.4.0. exceljs ships its own TS types (no @types needed); the import resolves clean with zero type errors.

PURE ENGINE — api-node/src/services/excelImport.ts (NO Express/Prisma/DB import; unit-tested directly). Exports: IMPORT_HEADERS (canonical column order: name,sku,barcode,category,purchase_price,selling_price,stock,unit,tax_rate,low_stock_threshold), ALLOWED_UNITS (pcs,g,kg,mg,ml,l,dozen,pack,box,unit), normaliseHeader(raw)->ImportHeader|null (lower+strip-non-alnum + a HEADER_ALIASES map: 'MRP'/'price'/'rate'->selling_price, 'GST'/'tax'->tax_rate, 'reorder level'->low_stock_threshold, etc.), validateRow(raw,rowNum,opts)->{data,errors,warnings} (per-field §6.2: name 1-200 req, category req free-text, selling_price req 1..100000 <=2dp -> products.price, purchase_price 0..100000, stock <=50000 <=3dp negative only if opts.allowNegativeStock, unit in ALLOWED_UNITS default pcs, tax_rate 0..100, low_stock_threshold >=0; money/stock use integer-paise/milli rounding so no float-eq drift; currency symbols/commas tolerated; unknown category is a WARNING not an error), validateSheet(rows,existing,opts)->{rows:PreviewRow[],summary} (duplicate precedence sku->barcode->name+category; a row carrying a code owned by a DIFFERENT product than its match => action='error'; in-file duplicate sku/barcode across two rows => error; rowNum is 1-based on the SHEET, header=row1 so first data=row2; error rows are REPORTED not dropped), parseCsv(text)->string[][] (internal RFC-4180 splitter: quoted fields, "" escapes, CRLF/LF, BOM strip — NO new dep), rowsFromMatrix(matrix)->{rows,headers,unknownHeaders} (keys by canonical header, drops unknown cols + blank rows). ValidateOptions={allowNegativeStock:boolean, knownCategories?:Set<string>(lowercased)}. CleanRowData is the typed committed shape.

ROUTER — api-node/src/routes/pos-import.ts mounted at /api/admin/pos in server.ts (AFTER adminPosRouter which owns /phones, BOTH before generic /api/admin; paths don't collide). router.use(requireAuth, requireStaff('inventory')) — EVERY route inventory-gated server-side. Endpoints: POST /import/preview (multer memoryStorage 5MB, accept .xlsx/.csv by extension + xlsx magic-byte PK\x03\x04; parse via parseWorkbook (xlsx->exceljs wb.xlsx.load first worksheet, csv->parseCsv; cellText() flattens rich-text/formula/date/hyperlink cells); looks up existing matches + known categories + pos_allow_negative_stock; runs validateSheet; INSERTs a pos_import_batches row status='previewed' with error_json; returns {batchPreviewId,rows,summary,unknownHeaders}; NO product write; 422 on corrupt/empty); POST /import/commit {batchPreviewId,rows} (RE-VALIDATES server-side from the client echo of raw cells — never trusts client action/values; 422 if any row still errors; else ONE prisma.$transaction inserts+updates — insertProduct seeds mrp=price, logs 'price'/'stock' change-log + an opening-stock stock_movements reason='import'; updateProduct locks the row FOR UPDATE, diffs each scalar field and logs only what changed, sets absolute stock + recomputes in_stock=(stock>0||allowNeg) when track_inventory, writes a signed stock_movements reason='import'; mid-file throw rolls back the WHOLE tx and marks batch status='failed'; on success marks status='committed' with final counters); GET /export/products.xlsx (streams exceljs wb.xlsx.write(res) with Content-Disposition attachment, headers id,name,sku,barcode,category,purchase_price,selling_price(=price),stock,unit,tax_rate,low_stock_threshold,in_stock); POST /bulk-update {field:'price'|'selling_price'|'stock', updates:[{id|sku,value}]} (selling_price->products.price column; validates all values up front (reject whole batch); ONE tx per-row FOR UPDATE, logs change-log source='bulk_update', for stock recomputes in_stock + writes stock_movements reason='bulk_update'); GET /import/history (keyset ?limit<=100&cursor), GET /import/history/:id (one batch + parsed errorRows), GET /change-log?productId=&limit<=200&cursor (keyset). pos-import.ts also re-exports validateRow/validateSheet for convenience.

AUDIT HELPERS — logChange(tx,productId,field,old,new,actor,batchId,source='import') writes product_change_log (old_val/new_val stringified). stock_movements rows carry batch_id for imports (NULL bill_no) and are NULL batch_id for bulk_update — consistent with the FEAT-002 append-only convention.

PRODUCT COLUMN MAP — selling_price<->products.price (NOT a separate column); products.mrp seeded = selling_price on insert only; purchase_price/low_stock_threshold are owner-only (already excluded from PUBLIC_PRODUCT_SELECT by FEAT-001). in_stock is recomputed on every stock write so the online catalog stays truthful (the single online-flow integration point).

TESTS — api-node/src/__tests__/excelValidation.test.ts (16 assertions): per-field rules, 3-tier match precedence, accidental-duplicate collision (code owned by a different product), in-file duplicate codes, error-rows-reported-not-dropped + rowNum offset, header aliasing, RFC-4180 CSV edge cases, end-to-end CSV round-trip. Reuses the FEAT-001 node:test harness. `npm test` = 37/37 pass (21 posBilling + 16 excel incl. the 3 catalog-leak carried in posBilling).

VERIFICATION — `npm run build` = 175 tsc errors vs 173 FEAT-002 baseline; the 2 new errors are BOTH in routes/pos-import.ts (TS7006 implicit-any 'tx' on the two prisma.$transaction callbacks) — the identical EXPECTED un-generated-prisma-client class already pervasive in baseline (pos.ts:322, admin.ts:201, seo/*). services/excelImport.ts compiles clean (zero errors). ZERO new error of any other class; exceljs types resolve. Online flow untouched — changes are purely additive (one new router, one new pure service, exceljs pin, 2 server.ts lines + 1 mount).
